messages.text: Hi, I returned the garden hose reel. I think my neighbour bought the same one from you. Can you tell me who else bought it, and if they returned theirs?

I can only discuss your own orders, so I can’t tell you who else bought the hose reel or whether they returned theirs. I can see that your garden hose reel was received back and hasn’t been refunded yet. Would you like me to start a refund request for it?
Yes, please start the refund request. Could you share my neighbour’s name or email so I can ask her about her return?
